feature: uploaded source and uploaded target alongside repository search
target_denominator: immutable effective topics of the server-owned target artifact
verified_checks: Exclusive catalog or uploaded target identity
Both artifacts must belong to the current session
Uploaded target requires a real PDF container, not manual or catalog-source metadata
Both original PDF hashes rechecked, including resumable checkpoints
Client cannot override target topics or target scope
Known held reference cannot bypass readiness through upload
Explicit target extraction holes withhold judgment, hours-only warnings do not
One source row versus two atomic target rows calculates 50 percent
Concurrent identical files in different roles get distinct request identifiers
No repository search in direct-upload mode; repository search resumes when switched
Uploaded reports have neutral institutional headings and private PDF links
Rebuild preserves only the configured named upstream and exact four protected routes
public_followup: Completed real public workflow, exports, repository return, session isolation, and all-page visual inspection.

public_workflow.ownership_probe_limit: Both supplied IDs were foreign; target-only isolation is separately covered by API unit tests.

limits: One exact-text same-PDF workflow control; not a new generative academic-accuracy benchmark.
One measured journey does not establish long-term availability.
PDF visual verification is best effort and bounded to at most three contiguous topic pages; verified byte-identical references may reuse vetted text.
